Godot v4.7.2.stable - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 02 Jun 2026 18:26:58 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (nvidia; 610.43.02) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700K CPU @ 3.80GHz (16 threads) - 31.19 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

I looked into this on current `master` (d2ea80d0cf) and your diagnosis is right. The counter in `EditorPerformanceProfiler::update_monitors()` restarts at 0 after the already-tracked monitors are filtered out of `names`, so it no longer lines up with `p_types`.

That also explains @dukeman74's ~50 process frames threshold: the debugger polls custom monitor names only once per second
(`RemoteDebugger::PerformanceProfiler::tick()`), so the monitors have to land in separate polls for the offsets to shift.

Introduced in 1a8306bbc1 ("Allow custom monitors to select desired type"), which matches it being reproducible from 4.6 onwards.

I tested your suggested fix locally with before/after builds and it resolves the issue, so I opened a PR with it. Credit for the diagnosis is yours.
